sources.temporalCoverage: 2018; KoStat/SGIS-derived submunicipal boundaries, distributed as geoBoundaries gbOpen KOR ADM3.
sources.scenarioDateCaveat: The game starts 2020-01-01. This acquired layer represents 2018, not an exact reconstruction of administrative changes through 2020. Source feature IDs are geoBoundaries shapeID, not guessed Korean administrative codes. Existing country envelope/coast/islands/shared border remain authoritative and alignment is independently tested.
sources.originalCrs: OGC:CRS84 (longitude,latitude); equivalent 2D positions to EPSG:4326 under the contract axis order

preprocessing.description: Read the fixed geoBoundaries KOR ADM3 2018 GeoJSON; verify shapeGroup/shapeType/shapeID and CRS84; preserve every source geometry/coordinate/component/hole; map properties to the common schema. Original source administrative parent codes are unavailable, so sourceParentId is null. No clipping, simplification, snapping, grid, boundary filling or geometry repair in this adapter. The shared C-owned candidate engine performs all coarse-parent intersections and diagnostics.

Retain all 179 original shapeID feature identities and all polygon coordinates/components/holes unchanged. Map shapeName to name; sourceParentId=null because no native ADM1 field is supplied. CRS84 WGS84 values require no numeric conversion. Common pinned generator alone intersects coarse parents. No simplification, snap, repair, synthetic fill, global IDs or publication.

topology.method: Edges from the same exact polygonized faces as country cells; no independent clipping or global union.

method: Joint exact source/coarse/P0 arrangement. Zero source coordinates moved; no extrapolated lines; unmatched fixed P0 land explicitly retains coarse provenance. Other 245 countries unchanged.
